current.text: He comes off the bench for the Lakers, behind Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves.
Experts do not expect him to start.
He only has fantasy value with about 26% usage and 30 minutes. That would take Doncic or Reaves missing a lot of games. Until then he is at most a stash in deep formats.
Do not draft him at his ESPN rank of 100. He is not expected to be even a back-end fantasy option.
Yahoo lists him as questionable with a lower leg injury.
The Lakers have the second most back-to-backs in the league. Their playoff schedule is 3-4-3 games for a March 28 end, which is in the bottom half of the league.

durable.text: He is an undersized guard and a poor passer. He has always been a weak assist player for a guard.
He is usually an efficient scorer and a good three-point shooter.
He is a notoriously bad fantasy player in category leagues.

note: He is not a draft target in our 12-team league. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 209, ESPN rank 150), he went undrafted last season, and he sits behind Doncic and Reaves as a bench guard who played only 23.7 minutes last season. His 86% FT% on about 4 attempts and his scoring can help guard-heavy builds in a pinch, but his low rebounds and blocks and 2.4 turnovers per game cap his value. In the first weeks, check his lower leg (Yahoo Q) and watch the waiver wire if Doncic or Reaves misses time, since that is the only path to the 30 minutes he needs.
